messages:
sara: Quick — proposing a 90m copy lab Mon to finalize Hosted / Dedicated / Private landing heroes + webinar landing + inbound routing. Deliverable: 2 hero variants per mode, webinar CTA, HubSpot routing doc.

leo: +1. PLG tone for Hosted, economics for Dedicated, controls for Private. keep heroes one-line + 2 bullets.

anya: i'll attach a tiny benchmark one-pager (latency distribution + batching impact) and two customer quotes.

matt: inbound fields I'll draft: use_case, team_size, compliance checkbox, expected_rps. routing rules: if team_size>50 OR compliance=true -> enterprise-sales; else if use_case==evaluation -> webinar_nurture; else -> demo_queue. will add utm_campaign=tri_mode_site.

julia: timeboxes: 20m hero, 30m value props, 20m webinar landing, 15m routing + tracking, 5m wrap.

content-bot: Reminder: attach pre-read 24h before meeting. template: ./copy/briefs/landing-copy-lab.md

sara: owners: leo (heroes + launch angles), anya (benchmarks + slides), matt (HubSpot wiring + tracking), julia (facilitate), sara (final sign-off). pre-read due Sun 5pm PT.

leo: quick hero drafts to iterate in the lab:
- Hosted A: "Start in minutes — production-ready inference"
- Hosted B: "Instant LLM features, no infra required"
- Dedicated A: "Reserved capacity — SLA-backed throughput"
- Dedicated B: "Predictable throughput, optimized unit cost"
- Private A: "Run inference in your VPC — enterprise controls"
- Private B: "Air-gapped serving, full data custody"

matt: confirmation page snippet for tracking: `window.dataLayer.push({event: 'lead_submitted', utm_campaign: 'tri_mode_site'})`. will draft HubSpot workflow and 48h auto-nudge.

sara: perfect. we'll finalize during the lab and aim to publish the launch post + webinar invite next Tue. thanks! :tada:
